Windows ensure_current_user_peer returns Unsupported unconditionally. The proposed unconditional ordinary-listener gate would reject every Windows AF_UNIX connection, including the existing cross-platform WS/RPC/ping regression.
Agentd uses OwnerLocalListener/Incoming/Stream on Windows and authenticates a real named-pipe client token against an owner-only protected DACL; that does not protect the app-server AF_UNIX stream.
Changing only cfg to omit Windows avoids the functional regression but leaves its authorization boundary unimplemented, so it is not an accepted resolution.

publication_decision: FROZEN_BLOCKED_BY_PARENT: do not publish the current Unix-only-tested postimages, do not cfg-away Windows authorization, and do not introduce an OwnerLocal wire-protocol migration in this consolidation round.

minimal_af_unix_interface_contract.unchanged_call_order: For fresh listeners check the accepted connected peer before WebSocket upgrade, application frames, connection admission, or allocating an unbounded connection task. Preserve Linux inherited owner-or-root policy and cancellation.
minimal_af_unix_interface_contract.unix: Retain the current kernel peer-credential implementation and same-euid rule. The existing inherited supervisor owner-or-root exception remains a separate, explicit branch.
minimal_af_unix_interface_contract.windows_backend: A Windows implementation must fail closed on unsupported peer-identity API, malformed PID/token data, inaccessible peer token, foreign SID, or a privilege/impersonation policy mismatch. It must derive identity from the accepted socket, not caller metadata, pathname owner, PID files or an asserted username.
implementation_surface: codex-rs/uds/src/lib.rs: delegate the Windows branch to a dedicated Windows peer module without changing UnixStream wire type
new Windows peer module: WSAIoctl(SIO_AF_UNIX_GETPEERPID) plus owned process/token handles, checked TokenUser SID comparison and documented privilege policy
codex-rs/uds/Cargo.toml: only required windows-sys features; regenerate canonical Cargo/Bazel metadata as required

minimal_af_unix_interface_contract.unresolved_security_obligation: SIO_AF_UNIX_GETPEERPID exposes a PID, not an authenticated current thread token. An accepted-socket authorization design must justify peer-process lifetime/PID reuse, socket duplication or delegation, impersonation and elevation. OpenAI upstream client-side daemon verification is implementation evidence, not qualification of this server-side boundary.
